title.value: Prototype-Sample Relation Distillation: Towards Replay-Free Continual Learning
title.justification: The title clearly states the primary focus of the paper, which is on a novel method for continual learning without replay buffers.
title.quote: Prototype-Sample Relation Distillation: Towards Replay-Free Continual Learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes a novel continual learning method called Prototype-Sample Relation Distillation (PRD) which eliminates the need for storing previous task data. This method uses representation learning combined with supervised contrastive loss and a unique distillation loss to preserve class prototypes relative similarities in the absence of prior task data. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in task-incremental settings without replay buffers.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on computational aspects of continual learning in AI and ML, without a direct link to sustainability, climate, or ecological development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In Continual learning (CL) balancing effective adaptation while combating catastrophic forgetting is a central challenge.
